mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.task_name AS taskName, t.template_id AS templateId, t.status, t.current_node_id AS currentNodeId, t.current_handler_id AS currentHandlerId, t.finished_node_count AS finishedNodeCount, t.total_node_count AS totalNodeCount, t.create_time AS createTime, s.handler_user_id AS ownerUserId, u.real_name AS ownerName, u.emp_no AS ownerEmpNo, u.dept_name AS ownerDept, -- 当前处理人 = 当前节点的全部待办处理人（任一完成即可）；无待办时回退为当前指针处理人 CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_task_node tn3 WHERE tn3.task_id = t.id AND tn3.node_id = t.current_node_id AND tn3.submit_status = 0) THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(u3.real_name SEPARATOR '、') FROM flow_task_node tn3 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON u3.id = tn3.handler_user_id WHERE tn3.task_id = t.id AND tn3.node_id = t.current_node_id AND tn3.submit_status = 0) ELSE cu.real_name END AS currentHandlerName, cn.node_name AS currentNodeName FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_task_node s ON s.node_type = 1 AND s.id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM flow_task_node WHERE task_id = t.id AND node_type = 1) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.handler_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = t.current_handler_id LEFT JOIN flow_template_node cn ON cn.id = t.current_node_id WHERE COALESCE(t.dispatch_id, t.id) = #{dispatchId} ORDER BY t.id ASC
